tools.name: search_voices
tools.description: Find licensed AI voices on Worder by language plus free text: name, accent, delivery tag (warm, calm, energetic...), actor or sample label. Each word is matched on its own and the voices matching the most words come first. Returns the voice's per-second price in USD, its samples (as page links), the use cases its actor excludes, and links to listen and generate. Use list_languages to see what languages have voices.

query.description: Free text: a name, an accent, a delivery such as 'warm' or 'energetic', or an actor.

language.description: A base language (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian) or a variant such as "Spanish (Mexico)".

tools.name: get_voice
tools.description: Full public details of one voice by id: actor, language, price per second, samples, direction tags, excluded use cases, and the links to listen and generate.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: The languages Worder voices speak, with the number of public voices per language and per country variant, and a link to each language's catalog page.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate how many seconds of audio a script will produce with a given voice and what it will cost in USD at that voice's per-second price, the way Worder bills it.

script.description: The text to be spoken, direction tags included.

tools.name: how_to_order
tools.description: The steps to go from a chosen voice to a downloaded audio file, including pricing, previews, credits and the refund guarantee.

tools.name: about_worder
tools.description: What Worder is, how voice actors are paid, what happens to voice data, which languages are supported and how pricing works.
